source_text: Peer-reviewed analyses indicate potential for post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), depression, and low self-esteem, stemming from the procedure's early age (typically 6-7 years) and secrecy, which fosters dissociation and long-term emotional suppression. [38] [39]
